title: Seller month in the seller's own time zone
desc: The seller goal and its forecast count the month in the Market's zone, because the rollups are by Market day (ADR-0005 prefers the owning party's zone). Count it in the seller's zone once reporting keeps seller-zone days.
src: Dashboards v2 phase 2, monthly targets PR
trig: A Market spans more than one time zone with sellers in several of them
